title: 3.5 Countries and Nationalities
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to give a name and limited age/origin/job information and describe simple possession.
goal: Recognize four country-nationality pairs and use fixed origin question and answer patterns.
grammar_function: Where are you from? I am from country. I am nationality. Where is learned as a fixed origin-question chunk; spatial Where is not generalized yet.
prerequisite: 3.3 be forms and 3.4 supported personal questions.
speaking_outcome: Repeat two origin exchanges and four country/nationality statements.
